card.name: "the" before fruit and field
card.fires_on: The word "the" in produce-handling text, right before a likely noun like fruit, field, vegetable or packing area. Also a few odd word starts like "st" in stables.

modes.label: "the" before produce

modes.label: Odd word starts
modes.description: Scattered partial words in farm or historical text, such as the start of stables or cane tops.
